description: This file defines a set of React components and styles for implementing a navigation menu using Radix UI primitives and custom styling. It includes components like NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, etc., that compose a accessible and styled navigation menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main container component for the navigation menu that optionally includes a viewport.

methods.name: NavigationMenuList
methods.description: Wrapper for the list of navigation items.

methods.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers dropdown behaviors for menu items, including an icon indicator.

methods.name: NavigationMenuContent
methods.description: Contains the dropdown content for navigation items.

methods.name: NavigationMenuViewport
methods.description: Displays the viewport area for the dropdown content.

methods.name: NavigationMenuLink
methods.description: Link elements within the menu for navigation.

methods.name: NavigationMenuIndicator
methods.description: Visual indicator component for active or open menu items.
